# ShaderLOD
screen.shaderlod = ShaderLOD
option.SHADERLOD_ENABLED = Distance LOD
option.SHADERLOD_ENABLED.comment = Reduce shadow, AO, fog, cloud, SSR and POM work with distance, including DH terrain.
option.SHADERLOD_USE_MOD_CONFIG = Use ShaderLOD mod config
option.SHADERLOD_USE_MOD_CONFIG.comment = Use live mod values when bridge version 1 or 2 is available; otherwise use these options.
option.SHADERLOD_NEAR = Near boundary (blocks)
option.SHADERLOD_FAR = Far boundary (blocks)
option.SHADERLOD_TRANSITION = Transition width (blocks)
option.SHADERLOD_DEBUG = Show LOD zones
option.SHADERLOD_DEBUG.comment = Tint opaque vanilla terrain green/full, amber/medium, red/far. Includes DH; excludes sky and hand.

option.SHADERLOD_PRESET = LOD preset
value.SHADERLOD_PRESET.0 = Balanced
value.SHADERLOD_PRESET.1 = Performance
value.SHADERLOD_PRESET.2 = Aggressive
option.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_NEAR = Cloud near boundary (blocks)
option.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_FAR = Cloud far boundary (blocks)
option.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_TRANSITION = Cloud transition width (blocks)
option.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_TRANSITION.comment = Entire transition band, clamped to avoid overlap or negative starts. Narrow bands retain full quality overhead when using short cloud thresholds.
option.SHADERLOD_PRESET.comment = Higher presets lower actual ray/sample budgets. Aggressive bypasses far AO.

option.SHADERLOD_CACHED_SKY = Reduce cached sky-map work
option.SHADERLOD_CACHED_SKY.comment = Global cloud-lighting/reflection approximation: Performance halves cached cloud budgets, Aggressive uses eighth budgets (effect minima apply); Balanced and disabled stay full.

option.SHADERLOD_PRESERVE_LIGHTING = Preserve shadows and occlusion
option.SHADERLOD_PRESERVE_LIGHTING.comment = Keep original PCF, screen-space shadow, GTAO and SSAO budgets. Recommended: retain tree depth while reducing cloud/fog/water work.

option.SHADERLOD_CLOUDS = Cloud sampling LOD
option.SHADERLOD_CLOUDS.comment = Independent compile-time pack control; off restores original effect work. Mod config still controls global enabled/preset.
option.SHADERLOD_WATER = Water surface LOD
option.SHADERLOD_WATER.comment = Independent compile-time pack control; off restores original effect work. Mod config still controls global enabled/preset.
option.SHADERLOD_FOG = Volumetric fog LOD
option.SHADERLOD_FOG.comment = Independent compile-time pack control; off restores original effect work. Mod config still controls global enabled/preset.
option.SHADERLOD_SSR = Reflection tracing LOD
option.SHADERLOD_SSR.comment = Independent compile-time pack control; off restores original effect work. Mod config still controls global enabled/preset.
option.SHADERLOD_MATERIALS = Material parallax LOD
option.SHADERLOD_MATERIALS.comment = Independent compile-time pack control; off restores original effect work. Mod config still controls global enabled/preset.

option.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_MODE = Cloud transition candidate
value.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_MODE.0 = Existing stochastic
value.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_MODE.1 = Separate tier noise
value.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_MODE.2 = Smooth integer budgets
option.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_MODE.comment = Experimental modes 1/2; mode 0 preserves existing sampling policy.
option.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_OVERHEAD = Preserve full overhead sampling
option.SHADERLOD_CLOUD_OVERHEAD.comment = Experimental modes 1/2 only: shift distance bands using actual camera/layer geometry. Invalid or above-shell reference retains full budgets.

# Profiles
option.SHADERLOD_WATER_ANALYTIC=Analytic distant water normals
option.SHADERLOD_WATER_ANALYTIC.comment=Experimental, default off: compute medium/far slopes in one evaluation; benefit unverified. Near water and shadow caustics keep original finite differences.
option.SHADERLOD_WATER_NEAR=Water medium distance
option.SHADERLOD_WATER_FAR=Water low distance
option.SHADERLOD_WATER_TRANSITION=Water transition width
